description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for the TwoFactorConfiguration entity, used for managing two-factor authentication configurations within the application. It includes methods for retrieving configurations by name and listing all configurations.

classes.name: TwoFactorConfigurationRepository
classes.description: A repository interface for managing TwoFactorConfiguration entities, conditionally enabled based on application properties.

methods.name: findByName
methods.description: Retrieves a TwoFactorConfiguration entity by its name.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all TwoFactorConfiguration entities.
